summary: Contextual action slot reliability and visual polish

changes.title: Single-slot priority and expiry
changes.detail: Centralize compact action ownership, exclude provider/full-paste content and explicit toolbar states, enforce monotonic editor action expiry at tap time, and retain RTL geometry. Add exhaustive ownership and deadline regression tests.

changes.title: Clean action transitions and accessibility
changes.detail: Keep functional dividers only while the action is live; avoid restarting an exiting animation, remove expired actions from accessibility, clear retired drawable and label, and exclude the hidden paste area from accessibility. Preserve the existing design and motion timing.
